description: This file defines an abstract class 'ForeachWriter' used in Apache Spark for custom data processing in streaming queries. It provides lifecycle methods for opening, processing, and closing data partitions during streaming execution.

classes.name: ForeachWriter
classes.description: An abstract class for writing custom logic to process streaming data in Spark, with methods for opening, processing, and closing data partitions.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes processing for a data partition; returns true if the partition should be processed.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes individual data rows during streaming.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes processing for a data partition, with optional error handling.
